# API & LLM Security Checklist: Workout Session Tracking

**Purpose**: Review the clarity, completeness, consistency, and measurability of API and natural-language security requirements
**Created**: 2026-11-23
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md), [REST API contract](../contracts/rest-api.md), [plan.md](../plan.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `$speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

## Requirement Completeness

- [ ] CHK001 Are all session and exercise operations in the API contract traceable to a user-facing requirement or acceptance scenario? [Completeness, Spec §FR-001–016, Contract §Endpoints]
- [ ] CHK002 Is the required owner identity source documented for every owner-scoped operation, including the expected behavior when the host does not supply an identity? [Assumption, Spec §FR-015, Plan §Constitution Check]
- [ ] CHK003 Are the date, time, and time-zone inputs defined consistently for manual session creation and natural-language session creation? [Consistency, Spec §FR-001–002/014, Contract §POST /api/sessions and §POST /api/sessions/parse]
- [ ] CHK004 Are all parser outcomes documented, including saved-to-new-session, saved-to-existing-session, clarification, unsupported exercise, invalid input, and provider failure? [Completeness, Spec §FR-010–016, Contract §POST /api/sessions/parse]

## Requirement Clarity

- [ ] CHK005 Are status codes and JSON response shapes specified for each success and failure outcome, including the rationale for returning JSON on deletion? [Clarity, Contract §Shared Conventions and §Endpoints]
- [ ] CHK006 Is it clear how a user answers a clarification request and how the clarified input is associated with the original description before saving? [Gap, Spec §User Story 3, Contract §POST /api/sessions/parse]
- [ ] CHK007 Are the conditions for appending to an existing session, creating a new session, or asking the user to choose among matches stated consistently? [Clarity, Spec §FR-014, Contract §POST /api/sessions/parse]
- [ ] CHK008 Are invalid weights, unsupported exercises, missing set values, and ambiguous exercises mapped to clear and distinct user correction paths? [Clarity, Spec §FR-011–013, Contract §POST /api/sessions/parse]

## Requirement Consistency

- [ ] CHK009 Do the requirements consistently distinguish permitted zero weight from invalid zero repetitions? [Conflict, Spec §Edge Cases and §Assumptions, Contract §POST /api/sessions/{sessionId}/exercises]
- [ ] CHK010 Are per-user privacy requirements consistent with authentication being outside scope and the plan's host-supplied identity prerequisite? [Consistency, Spec §FR-015 and §Assumptions, Plan §Constitution Check]
- [ ] CHK011 Are all-endpoint JSON response requirements consistent with the documented HTTP status behavior and deletion response? [Consistency, Plan §Technical Context, Contract §Shared Conventions and §DELETE]

## Acceptance Criteria Quality

- [ ] CHK012 Are the 85% automated coverage target and 80% parser evaluation threshold defined with distinct scopes, denominators, and pass rules? [Measurability, Plan §Summary and §Technical Context, Research §Parser evaluation and §Automated test coverage]
- [ ] CHK013 Is semantic parser correctness defined in terms of expected catalog identity, set count, weights, reps, and clarification disposition? [Measurability, Research §Parser evaluation, Contract §LLM Output Validation Boundary]

## Scenario and Edge Case Coverage

- [ ] CHK014 Are malformed model output, catalog mismatch, provider unavailability, and failed persistence each covered by explicit no-write and recovery requirements? [Coverage, Spec §Edge Cases and §FR-016, Contract §POST /api/sessions/parse]
- [ ] CHK015 Are requirements defined for repeated or concurrent parse submissions so retries cannot silently duplicate an exercise or session? [Gap, Exception Flow, Spec §FR-014, Contract §POST /api/sessions/parse]
- [ ] CHK016 Are requirements for request size, provider timeout, and retry behavior specified or explicitly excluded for the external LLM dependency? [Gap, Dependency, Spec §Assumptions, Plan §Constraints]
- [ ] CHK017 Are requirements for handling workout text and provider error details in logs and client responses explicit enough to protect user data and secrets? [Coverage, Security, Constitution §Quality and Security, Plan §Constraints]

## Notes

- Mark items `[x]` only after review confirms the requirement-quality criterion is satisfied.
- Leave items unchecked when they still require clarification, correction, or reviewer evaluation.
- `$speckit-implement` reads checklist checkbox state as a gate and must not modify markers.
- `checklists/requirements.md` has a separate built-in lifecycle maintained by `$speckit-specify` and `$speckit-clarify`.
- Add comments or findings inline and link relevant resources or documentation.
- Items are numbered sequentially for easy reference.
